about: Which question situations have had their prompts, options and worked steps read by a person, not only checked by tools/check-answers (which tests the last step). Exam situations come first, the order of the reading pass. See curriculum/README.md, "Sign-off list". Checked by tests/unit/signoff.test.mjs.

statuses.unread: No one has read the prompts and worked steps yet.
statuses.review-read: Some units were read in a review and their defects fixed; the rest of the situation is not confirmed.
statuses.signed-off: The Curriculum Author read every unit, representation and method: prompt, options, worked steps and probes.

situations.note: Read every unit, representation, method and format (one exported question per cell and format) and the concept probes. Fixed: missing-form filler claimed surd roots when Δ < 0; match-three-forms steps now find the forms and options are no longer a majority vote; form-for-feature key no longer the only option of its form; eight method labels matched to their steps; duplicate and "1 ×" glitches in the conditions steps; h-k-from-vertex prompt. Tests: test_reading_quadratic.gd.

Read every unit, representation, method and format (one exported question per cell and format) and the concept probes. Recomputed every key and option: all right. Fixed: general-form answers show the multiply-and-collect step; every working finds the gradients it uses (two points, L₁ and L₂ in general form, the rotated step); a parallel k question has no m₁ × m₂ = −1 working, and the product test explains a pair that isn't perpendicular; method names fit the question (no 'on the graph' without a graph, no 'in a table' without a table, intercept form isn't 'cover-up', a given equation isn't 'point-gradient' or 'find c'); set-zero works on the line as given; missing-coordinate works out the known leg first; the quarter-turn product finds both gradients; notation (−a/b, bracketed fractions, a coefficient of −1, 'down' and 'left' for negative steps). Open: gradient-from-general with |a| = |b| still has key ± 1 nudges (every slip lands on ±1). Tests: test_reading_line.gd.

Read every unit, representation, method and format (one exported question per cell and format) and the concept probes. Fixed (apply): an order-changes-rule filler that restated the key; a false 'only one graph passes through it' in sketch track-a-point; the √x copied-domain slip on log domains (now fn-transform-apply#19); fractions after ÷ and × bracketed; 'subtract 1.8', not 'add −1.8'; step-by-step and solve-for-input methods that repeated the mapping rule now move the point or solve; no key ± 1 for image points with x = 0; no non-terminating fillers on Paper 2; asymptote, rule-from-moves, order, undo and reflect working find the answer. Fixed (describe and order probes): track points only for a translation and the scale rule only for a stretch; the inside-as-outside slip right for both signs; fillers that repeated 'same graph' replaced; order-from-bracket's stretch-then-translate method only when the stretch is first; the two-orders filler no longer equals the key; working finds each order, pair, reverse and point a move at a time; describe-from-graphs divides and subtracts; graph views read g from P and Q; no 'scale factor 1' filler; vector-from-key-point keeps its moved-point slip; 'sin(5t)', not '1 sin(5t)'; vertex-form rules with one constant; 1 ÷ (1/b) bracketed. The method names now read a·f(b(x − c)) + d and (x/b + c, ay + d), as the working does. Open: exact fractions such as 5/6 among Paper 2 decimals. Tests: test_reading_tapp.gd, test_reading_tdesc.gd.
